column7: A storage error on /auth/login's username lookup (before any password check) was audited auth.login_failed and kept the per-IP login-budget slot. Now core returns ErrLoginNotEvaluated (text still "invalid credentials"; the anti-enumeration dummy bcrypt is spent before the branch), the handler audits auth.login_error and hands the slot back, and the response is byte-for-byte the one an unknown username gets (status, body, headers compared against that control). Red on unmodified #2956: no auth.login_error, slot kept. Ported from #2846 (RACE-FIX-2), replaced by AUTH-AUDIT-1.
